claims.text: All who plan to or could become preg: daily folic acid 0.4–0.8 mg (400–800 mcg)
claims.quote: The USPSTF recommends that all persons planning to or who could become pregnant take a daily supplement containing 0.4 to 0.8 mg (400 to 800 mcg) of folic acid.
claims.locator: USPSTF Recommendation: Folic Acid Supplementation to Prevent Neural Tube Defects: Preventive Medication (August 1, 2023)

claims.text: Hx NTD-affected preg or on anticonvulsants: 4–5 mg daily
claims.quote: High-risk women, including those with a history of neural tube defect–affected pregnancies or those taking anticonvulsants, are recommended to receive 4 to 5 mg daily during this period.
